data.camera: cowboy shot, walking through a Liberio city street in Marley military uniform
data.description: 马莱的街巷里，三笠穿着黑色军装制服走在异国的屋檐下，胸甲与束带收束出挺拔的轮廓，红围巾在灰暗的色调中是唯一的亮色——「无论走到哪里，我都会找到你。」
data.promptProse: Mikasa watches the road as she walks beneath the Liberio eaves, her red scarf bright against gray daylight and stone.
data.title: 三笠 · 马莱街头
data.animaCaption: She watches the road beneath the Liberio eaves.
